examples.en: Scientists have also scrutinised whether it's possible to preserve the ice sheets of Greenland with reinforced high-tension cables, preventing icebergs from moving into the sea.
examples.zh: 科学家们还仔细研究了是否有可能用加固的高压电缆来保护格陵兰岛冰原，防止冰山流入大海。

examples.en: She provided both the good work and the good chemistry every high-tension effort needs.
examples.zh: 在高压之下取得成就，需要优质的工作和融洽的人际关系，她两方面都能提供。

examples.en: Catlin said his company designed the system to work like the high-tension mooring systems that hold up floating oil RIGS.
examples.zh: 卡特林说他们公司设计的发电系统工作方式与支撑浮油钻塔的高张力系泊系统相类似。
